result: Partial visual pass: selected Linux and WASM captures inspected. Willo flying bodies, orbit spacing, flashing attack presentation, Mullighoul hover and independent children are visible. Source artwork and all-angle/crowd readability are not certified.
observations: Native and browser cohort captures show spaced flying bodies around the player, with pale yellow-green bodies and ground shadows. One member can overlap a cliff; the existing hidden-enemy outline appears there.

The initial late native live capture placed the fleeing parent behind the top-right HUD and a child near the health panel. An additional frame65 capture clearly shows the elevated walker body and nearby Willo. This is a camera/readability limitation, not proof of a missing actor.

The river capture shows scenery and existing red outlines but is insufficient alone to prove water traversal. The native movement fixture independently verifies actual crossing while respecting rocks; browser telemetry confirms hover in the river room.
Death captures show four Willos: one previously emitted live child and three independent death children. This does not mean the death payload itself is four.

Both natural captures preserve production actors and scenery. The Mullighoul body, spawned Willo and other ordinary residents are visible together. The natural Willo room includes the existing attraction statue; speed changes are verified by telemetry.
Existing generic yellow windup lines remain, alongside the new Willo Warn flash. No whole-scene filter or source sprite import was used.
limits: Selected frames/cameras only. Generic Original fly/walker shapes remain; full visual-equivalence and broad readability acceptance are open.
No controlled performance conclusion is drawn from screenshot FPS counters during concurrent tests.
